payload.text: vc, 23 Nov 2026: cc's design for STca1b7f9 (35510494: objective, context, design.md and four WPs), read against hv decision 13, is approved for its spike, M1 to M3, once vc has read the probes' bytes. Code waits on three things: the spike's results, each WP's body and acceptance criteria recorded, and hv's word on WP5, Appgate's grab point, which cc recommends and vc backs. vc's five notes to cc, sent with this read: (1) The two ways past a full-screen desktop on the laptop alone, leaving full screen or Mission Control, were vc's words in the question decision 13 answered, not hv's, so design.md says so. Turning down leaving full screen is cc's design choice, and vc tells hv it as that. (2) A void bindings record, after a reboot or a logout, falls back to today's rules until the next Save Desk. The design and help/arngz.md say so, and AC 13's steps save each desk in the same session first. (3) The design says what keeps two runs from losing each other's write of the record. The engine refuses a second apply (arngz:999-1000), and the design says whether a discover --save can run beside one. (4) WP5 is one rule: a press only where the deepest element is the web area itself, and only in the title strip. Appgate is a VPN client, so M3's point is chosen by that rule. (5) A window that newest's rule misses is left unarranged, never mis-taken, and the design says so. The spike moves hv's windows, so hv runs it in hv's own terminal, booked at the Desk. dc reads the code before it lands.
